chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 422: Han Li's Swords Complete, an Ancient Pearl Map, and the Storm Before War
chapter_meta_description: With his seventy-two Azure Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords finished and the Gold Devourer Beetles hatched, Han Li is pulled from his quiet routine by a mysterious pearl map—just as the Starfall Sea teeters on the edge of open chaos.
og_description: Han Li's swords are done. The beetles are hatched. And a neighbor arrives with a pearl that changes everything.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 422 – A Pearl, a Promise, and a World on the Brink
twitter_description: Han Li emerges from seclusion with his swords complete—only to find the Starfall Sea in chaos and a mysterious ancient map waiting at his doorstep.

lore_anchors.definition: A set of seventy-two flying swords refined by Han Li as his intrinsic magical treasures; crafted from Divine Thunder Bamboo and nurtured for over twenty years, they are his signature combat asset.
A rare insect-type demon beast ranked middle-to-high in the strange-insect hierarchy; their larvae consume metal and can be weaponized as a swarm. Han Li has just completed binding them.
A ritual formation that uses a cultivator's essence blood to imprint a permanent control link onto a large number of creatures at once.
The supreme rulers of the Star Palace, the dominant power in the Starfall Sea; rumors of their incapacitation have thrown the entire region into political crisis.
Long-abandoned sites from a pre-sect era in the Starfall Sea, often sealed by formations and containing lost techniques or artifacts. Maps preserved in pearls are a hallmark of this era.
